description: The side panel's Subagents page: one row per subagent (a Task/Agent call) of this session, newest first, each opening its own transcript on a detail page.
opens: Status bar "⚙ ... running" button when a subagent is running
View button on a subagent's tool card in the chat (opens this page with that subagent's detail; opens from its row with the animation only if the list was already on screen)

parts.name: list
parts.shows: A boxed list of rows, newest at the top, scrolling. Empty: centred dim text.

parts.name: row
parts.shows: Left to right: a status mark (spinner while running, green tick when completed, grey stop mark when interrupted, red cross for failed or killed); a title and a one-line subtitle; a chevron › at the right. Title: the subagent's description (what Claude gave the call), or "Subagent" if none. Subtitle (one line) joined with " · ": subagent type (e.g. general-purpose) first if known; the status word only for endings the mark can't say (failed, killed); "N tool use(s)"; "N tokens" (12.3k style: 1.2k, 3.4M); duration in seconds with one decimal ("8.2s"); and while running, its current activity text last.

actions.does: opens its detail page (its row grows into the header)

decisions.said: Drop the running / completed words in the Processes view: the check mark already says it (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app's subagent rows write a status word only for endings the mark can't say (failed, killed); running and completed are shown by the mark alone.

parts.name: nested row
parts.shows: A subagent started by another subagent sits directly under its parent, indented one step per level, with a thin tree line drawn from the parent's status mark down to it (like a file in a folder). Its row is otherwise the same.

parts.name: detail page
parts.shows: A header, then the subagent's transcript set into the panel like the main chat (darker inside, its own scrolling, code blocks at natural height).

parts.name: header
parts.shows: Status mark (same as the row, updates live), the title as a heading (one line, ellipsised), under it the same one-line info as the row's subtitle (hidden if empty, wraps), and a back button ‹ at the right end.

parts.name: transcript
parts.shows: First the subagent's prompt as a user bubble (if known), then everything it does as in the main chat: replies, thinking, tool cards (including its own subagent calls, whose View button opens that nested subagent), results. It fills in live while the subagent runs. Right-click and zoom behave as in the main chat; the zoom size is the chat's.

actions.does: opens a find bar inside this transcript
opens that nested subagent's detail (replaces this one; the first goes back to its box)

decisions.said: A subagent's chat in the panel should have the main chat's background, set into a cutout with the main area's vignette, with the back button and title above it (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows a subagent's transcript set into the panel as the main chat is (its background, the same inset frame), with the back button and title above it on the panel.

parts.name: chat card link
parts.shows: In the main chat, a subagent's tool card has a View toggle button beside Prompt, where Output was; its Output is shown only for an error. Pressing View doesn't stay pressed; it opens this page.
text: Open this subagent in the side panel

actions.by: click View (tooltip "Open this subagent in the side panel")
actions.does: opens the panel on Subagents with this one open

decisions.said: For the Agent tool show Prompt, but Output should be View, which opens the subagent panel directly (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app's subagent card has Prompt and View; View opens that subagent in the side panel; Output appears only for an error.

states.name: running
states.shows: Spinner in row and header, activity text at the end of the subtitle, counts rising

states.name: completed
states.shows: Green tick; subtitle without a status word

states.name: interrupted
states.shows: Grey stop mark (a saved subagent that never finished)

states.name: failed or killed
states.shows: Red cross, and the word "failed" or "killed" first in the subtitle (after the type)

states.name: nested
states.shows: Indented under its parent with a tree line

states.name: viewing a session running elsewhere
states.shows: Another machine's subagents are fetched from it and listed the same way, transcripts included
